definitions.explanation: The final part of a sentence. In Japanese grammar it is where the predicate, politeness forms and sentence-final particles appear, so the word is common in explanations of style.

examples.japanese: {文末|ぶんまつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{句点|くてん}→句点：19157_kuten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧。
examples.english: Put a period at the end of the sentence.

examples.japanese: {文末|ぶんまつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧「です」⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please remove the です at the end of the sentence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{文末|ぶんまつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}し{手|て}→話し手：28073_hanashite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：02485_kimochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: In Japanese, the speaker's feelings often show in how the sentence ends.

notes:
A grammar and writing term. {文末|ぶんまつ}⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧ (sentence-final expressions) covers endings such as です・ます, だ・⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧, and particles like ⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧ and ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧. Its opposite is {文頭|ぶんとう} (beginning of a sentence).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {文末|ぶんまつ}⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧: sentence-final expression
- {文末|ぶんまつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{統一|とういつ}→統一：04551_touitsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make sentence endings consistent (all です・ます or all だ・⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧)
- {文末|ぶんまつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧: to put at the end of a sentence
